asset_set: Questionnaire Q15 option 1 — Managing e-commerce store

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under laptop and forearms — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle cardboard-fiber suggestion on shipping label via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: busy proactive entrepreneur energy — approachable small-business hustle, not a corporate SaaS dashboard
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: coral
accent.use: cart icon, shipping label edge, polo cuff trim

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: coral appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on laptop lid edge and notification badge
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and laptop base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: scrolls through a list of incoming orders
left_hand.grip: two-finger scroll gesture on the trackpad
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: applies a shipping label to a small parcel box
right_hand.grip: flat palm pressing the label smooth

pose.gesture_summary: mid-fulfillment freeze frame — one order packed and ready to ship
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of forearms multitasks between an open laptop showing a coral cart icon and a yellow order badge, and a small parcel box getting its shipping label smoothed into place. A roll of labels sits nearby. The scene reads as energetic small-business ownership — hands-on order fulfillment, not a passive corporate dashboard glance.

primary_objects.name: laptop with seller dashboard
primary_objects.detail: screen shows a simple coral cart icon and a yellow circular order badge, no readable text

primary_objects.name: parcel box
primary_objects.detail: small closed box with a shipping label being pressed on top

primary_objects.name: shipping label roll
primary_objects.detail: coral edge stripe, no readable barcode text

primary_objects.name: order notification badge
primary_objects.detail: simple circular badge with a plain dot, no numeral

subject.environment: light seller workstation desk surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from laptop scroll hand → laptop screen → label hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: desk edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: laptop silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, e-commerce platform brand, letter E, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, warehouse chaos, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. KursoKo quiz choice for "Managing e-commerce store". Style: flat vector, 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands — matches KursoKo RIASEC sticker family, NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms at a seller workstation. Left hand scrolls a laptop showing a coral #FF8A65 cart icon and a yellow #FFD54F order badge, no readable text. Right hand presses a shipping label onto a cardboard parcel box, with a label roll beside it. Smart-casual steel-blue polo sleeve rolled to mid-forearm with coral cuff stripe, yellow wristwatch. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C. Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half. Mood: busy, proactive small-business energy.
